description: This file defines a factory class for creating instances of IGrainDirectoryCache with different caching strategies, and includes a null implementation of the interface. It is part of the Orleans runtime, specifically related to grain directory caching mechanisms.

classes.name: NullGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: A null implementation of IGrainDirectoryCache that performs no caching operations.

methods.name: CreateGrainDirectoryCache
methods.description: Creates a new grain directory cache instance based on the provided options and services.

methods.name: CreateCustomGrainDirectoryCache
methods.description: Creates a custom grain directory cache, defaulting to LRU cache if no service is provided.
